CRM notes (shorthand):
- Lead inbound from signup form; small support SaaS (ticketing + scheduling). 51-200 employees. CTO + lead eng driving PoC.
- Primary ask: hosted API (self-serve) to power in-app chat widget with streaming for token-level UX + tool-calling to our booking microservice. Goal: reduce phone triage, automate routine bookings.
- Reported breakage: when using streaming (JSON mode) + function_call, our parser fails because stream sometimes emits partial JSON chunks (e.g. '"arguments": {"booking_time": "2026-03-01T14:00', then stream closes) — error observed: "Error: incomplete JSON in stream: unexpected end of input at position 812".
- Also seeing function name mismatch: schema expects 'create_booking' but model emitted 'CreateBooking' (case mismatch) or included extra fields (e.g. 'customer_email' vs 'email').
- They tried 'structured_output' mode with triple-backtick fences (markdown) — their parser doesn't strip fences, so downstream JSON parse fails.
- Quote from CTO on 2026-02-18: "We parse streaming token-by-token; partial JSON breaks our pipeline. Need a pattern that guarantees parsable JSON or a recommended fallback."
- Performance targets: throughput ~5-10 rps for widget peak, first-token latency <250ms preferred, end-to-end (including tool call) <1s ideal. Cost sensitivity: keep prompt + response tokens small (512 context target).
- Security: SOC2 required for procurement; want audit logging details and retention policy (they asked where logs live and retention TTL). SSO/SAML for app login is required.
- Troubleshooting steps attempted by customer:
  * disabled streaming -> function_call works (non-streaming full response)
  * enabled streaming -> saw truncated JSON & finish_reason 'length' occasionally
  * attempted to add explicit stop token ("
") but model still emitted markdown fences in some cases
  * tried canonicalizing function names in schema (snake_case vs CamelCase) — inconsistent results
- SE notes (Ethan): likely causes — buffered vs token-by-token JSON assembly in client; streaming with function_call sends function_call token stream but client must assemble until finish; some SDKs/parsers bail early on seeing '}' in middle of chunk. Also model sometimes emits explanatory text outside JSON when using 'structured_output' unless strict schema enforced.

  2) Provide example function schema best-practices: required fields, canonical names, enum constraints, and example for booking use-case.
  3) Share guidance on structured_output: avoid markdown fences in model outputs, use single top-level JSON object, include final sentinel token, and suggested stop sequences.
  4) Quick SOC2 + audit log FAQ doc + sample logs (where retained, TTL, redaction options) — link to drive doc (done).
- Next steps agreed: Priya to send sample booking schema and production parser code snippet (by 2026-03-12). Redwood to send streaming sample + schedule 30m POC sync week of 2026-03-15.
